description: mipyre — Python web framework with a Rust core (hyper + tokio + rustls + mimalloc): one pinned thread per physical core, each with its own PEP 684 sub-interpreter, so Python handlers run on every core at once. Opt-in features: gzip/brotli compression, rustls TLS with h2/h1 ALPN, precompressed static files, async Postgres via sqlx. Handlers are standard Python functions routed via decorators.
